title: Seller Performance Standing — Retired Points at Account Closing
content:
**Definition.** The active points at closing are the points of every violation recorded on the standing record less every point reversed, expired, stepped down or relieved; the listing-type points at closing are the same for listing policy and restricted product violations and the entries carrying those types, and the serious points at closing are the same for intellectual property, inauthentic complaint, product authenticity or review manipulation violations and the entries carrying those types. The retired points are the active points at closing multiplied by the retirement share of 0.5 and rounded down to a whole point, and never more than the retirement cap of 1 point. The product is worked to four decimal places before it is rounded down.

When a seller closes the selling account, the Seller Performance Standing record retires part of its active points; this is how that number is found.

## The three point totals at closing

| Total | Recorded points counted | Entries taken out |
|---|---|---|
| Active points at closing | every violation recorded | every reversal and every points-expiry entry (expiries, step-downs, reliefs) |
| Listing-type points at closing | listing policy and restricted product violations | entries carrying either of those types |
| Serious points at closing | intellectual property, inauthentic complaint, product authenticity and review manipulation violations | entries carrying any of those types |

## Calculation

The retired points are the active points at closing multiplied by 0.5, worked to four decimal places, rounded down to a whole point, and limited to 1 point.

## Worked figures (hypothetical records)

| Active points at closing | Multiplied by 0.5 | Rounded down | Retired points |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0.5000 | 0 | 0 |
| 2 | 1.0000 | 1 | 1 |
| 7 | 3.5000 | 3 | 1 (limited) |
| 0 | 0.0000 | 0 | 0 |

**A record in full.** Violations recorded: listing policy 2, restricted product 4, intellectual property 8 (14 in all). Entries: a reversal of 2 carrying listing policy, and a step-down of 3 carrying intellectual property. Active points at closing: 14 less 5, which is 9. Listing-type points at closing: 6 less 2, which is 4. Serious points at closing: 8 less 3, which is 5. Retired points: 9 multiplied by 0.5 is 4.5000, rounded down to 4, limited to 1.
